propositions: rebar transition --class not_a_bug on a bug with no actual defect incorrectly routes to completion verifier, which demands proof the nonexistent defect was fixed
close_disposition.verdict() returns None for not_a_bug when no replacement link exists, causing fallthrough to completion verification instead of accepting the RCA-backed class attestation
not_a_bug and escalated must become REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so verdict() mints deterministic (class, reason) attestations without invoking the verifier or requiring a replacement link
closing without --reason or --replacement must be refused at write time via txn.close_class_refusal, naming both paths as available alternatives
a live replacement link must short-circuit the reason requirement (checked first in verdict), preserving precedence and allowing reason as fallback for either class
